title: OP Cast
tagline: Move your Axelar Interchain token usnig a Frame from Optimism to base and vice-versa
description:
I built this using Axelar smart contracts using Onchainkit and the 100 lines of frames repository. I will soon be adding more supported chains to this frame, which presently supports optimism and base.

Currently it supports moving of Axelar interchain token from Optimism to base and vice-versa.

Frames are a Farcaster standard that may be embedded into any Farcaster client to provide authorised, interactive experiences.
